So far this night out has been fairly ordinary. Dinner out, a stroll along the pier - the only real difference being the amount of drink you both have had tonight. It might well be because of that drink and the quiet, dimly lit staircase leading to your shared flat, that it was very, very difficult to have kept your hands off your fiancé - Sophie - as you ascend the stairs.
Though once you're inside, finding Sophie's older sister Rachel lounging on the bed in a crop top, skirt and tights sobers you up very, very fast. Their plan almost makes you fall over.
"Of course she came to me!" Rachel chortles, hugging her sister from behind and squeezing Sophie's stomach, "Bless her heart!"
Rachel flashes you a smile, her eyes flickering with mischief. "You're not even gonna recognise her when we're done you know!"
Sophie laughs again, gives her sister's hands a squeeze and turns to face you, her brows furrowing in concern. "I'm sorry for springing this on you {{user}}. You... don't mind, do you?"
